title: Time-bound delegation: ephemeral role provisioning and automated access-evidence pipeline
creator: Priya Natarajan
description: Problem: Customers require demonstrable, time-scoped access controls for auditors and internal security reviews across hosted and private deployments. Current RBAC and SCIM flows support static roles and periodic manual reviews; we lack a standardized mechanism for ephemeral (time-bound) delegations, automated SCIM lifecycle reconciliation for temporary grants, and an evidence export that ties sessions/approvals to attestation artifacts. Goal: Implement ephemeral role provisioning (JIT-style TTL grants), SCIM extensions for temporary memberships, SSO/SAML approval hooks for delegations, and an evidence pipeline that produces auditable exports linking request, approver, grant duration, and revocation events. This ticket covers design and core implementation for infra + control plane components required for rollout to Dedicated and Private customers.
acceptance_criteria: API: POST /access/delegations creates ephemeral grant with start/expiry and returns grant-id
SCIM: enterprise/Group PATCH supports 'temporaryMembers' extension with expiry attribute and reconciler honors expiry
SSO flow: SAML/SSO assertion can include delegation metadata and approval events are logged to audit stream
Automatic revoke: grants expire automatically at TTL and cannot be used for new sessions post-expiry
Evidence export: daily bundle contains grant-id, subject, approver, scope, start, expiry, revoke events and link to session tokens where applicable
Tests: unit/integration tests validate grant lifecycle, SCIM reconciliation, and evidence serialization
Security review: design approved by Security and Privacy teams before public rollout
implementation_notes: Add Delegation service backed by existing entitlement DB with index on expiry for efficient sweep
Re-use token revocation hooks in serving runtime to mark cached KV entries invalid when grant revoked
SCIM: add 'urn:redwood:ext:temporaryMember':{memberId,expiresAt,issuedBy} to enterprise schema and extend reconcilers
SSO: define optional SAML AuthnContext extension for delegation-approval and wire to console approval UI
Console: lightweight approval modal with justification field, TTL selector (1h,8h,24h,custom up to policy limits), and optional email notification
Policy: default max TTL 24h for non-privileged roles; privileged roles require manager approval and audit logging retention 7 years for enterprise customers
Performance: ensure daily evidence export generation parallelizes by tenant shard to avoid peak window overload
rollout_plan: Phase 1 - Internal dogfooding: enable ephemeral grants for Redwood internal org; validate session revocation and evidence exports (2 weeks)
Phase 2 - Beta: opt-in for 3 enterprise customers with Dedicated and Private deployments; run weekly syncs and collect feedback (4 weeks)
Phase 3 - GA: enable feature flag for all accounts with default off for legacy; provide migration guide for existing review processes (2 weeks)
Phase 4 - Enforcement & analytics: expose metrics in Console and enable automated periodic review reminders tied to evidence reports (ongoing)
monitoring_and_alerting: Alert: >1% failed grant creation rate for any tenant in 15m window
SLOs: evidence_export_generation latency P95 < 10m for daily bundle per-tenant
Audit: all grant-related events emitted to audit-log topic with structured fields for downstream export
